projects.title: Quickbooks Analytics - Dashboard Business Management
projects.description:
Analytics123 is a powerful analytics tool for QuickBooks Online, offering nine strategic managerial views to optimize business management

Key Features: 
Annual Billing Summary: Provides an overview of annual billing, allowing for detailed analyses.
Profit and Loss Analysis: Shows a detailed analysis of all inputs and outputs, highlighting key issues and areas for improvement. 
Detailed Input Analysis: Displays detailed input analysis by invoice or category, organized by month or year, facilitating revenue flow understanding.
Graphical and Numerical Comparisons: Offers graphical and numerical views of all entries and exits, enabling month-by-month profitability analysis and comparisons with previous years and bank entries.
Expense Details: Provides detailed data on expenses, aiding in important cost-related decisions.
Sales Efficiency: Includes indicators and measurements of sales efficiency, comparing estimates and invoices, identifying promising estimates, and making forecasts.
Annual Results Comparison: Allows comparison of current results with those of previous years, using different filters for comprehensive analysis.
Bank and Credit Card Movements: Shows specific screens for bank accounts and credit card movements, with graphical representations.
Billing Process Analysis: Breaks down the billing process by quarter and product category, displaying monthly results and a detailed table with invoices and customers.

Benefits:
Problem Identification: Helps quickly identify financial and operational issues.
Informed Decision-Making: Provides detailed data supporting fact-based strategic decisions.
Process Optimization: Facilitates the analysis and optimization of financial processes, improving overall business efficiency.
Forecasting and Planning: Enhances forecasting and planning capabilities through comparative analyses and projections.

With Analytics123, businesses can turn financial data into valuable insights, promoting more effective and strategic management.

projects.title: Consolidation and Server Virtualization
projects.description:
Project Consolidation and Server Virtualization Platform on Windows Server 2012 with Hyper-V 3.0

The project was to consolidate and virtualize 25 servers from physical to virtual using Windows Server 2012 with Hyper-V 3.0. Hardware utilized as two blades in a blade PowerEdge R910 with storage AX4 / 5 with fiber chanel swits brocade.

With this project, it was possible to consolidate Hardware (70% were obsolete and guaranteed winning) and also the reduction with Microsoft licensing.

Other gains:

* Centralized Management
* Failover Clustering in Host's allowing the High Availability for Virtual Servers
* Cost Reduction with Licenses / Energy
* Scalability
* Backup's safer
* Reduction in Time Management / Creating New Servers
